svg.aria-label: crow-nest: one GPU, its own quant, two model families. Features, measurements, requirements.
svg.text: One GPU, its own quant, two model families.▍
An inference engine for one GPU: its own quantization, its own container, thin CUDA
kernels in Rust. OpenAI-compatible HTTP, and the engine behind Crow. Two models from the
original safetensors: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next as CNQ4.5-M and the dense Qwen3.8-27B as CNQ4.5.
VRAM lent to Crow while idle
Flash-Next: decode and prefill v0.3.0, one RTX 5090, Windows, 2026-09-13/14; VRAM loan #117, 2026-09-25.
27B: one RTX 5090, Linux, CROW_MMA=1 CROW_GRAPH=1, BF16 KV, 2026-09-27 (#95, #122). Conditions: docs/measurements.md, CHANGELOG.md
CNQ4.5: NVFP4 at 4.5 bits per weight
one .cnq file with a verification sidecar
thin kernels via NVRTC, Blackwell sm_120
HTTP API, Crow is the client
speculative decode, output identical to plain
both models, 1,024 to 1,280 tokens per image
